AERO_RESIST_CANSNOW.note: AR_406_FULL and AR_406 are run as VIC runs them (basin.simulate(aero_resist_cansnow=...)); AR_410 and AR_406_LS are refused (image driver: torchvic/io/options.py, docs/OPTIONS.md)

AGGFREQ.note: aggregation period, VIC's alarm: NSTEPS, NSECONDS..NDAYS, NMONTHS, NYEARS, DATE, NEVER; END and an absent AGGFREQ, which VIC 5 writes nothing for, are one whole-run record and every step

ALB_SRC.note: FROM_VEGLIB and FROM_VEGPARAM read the parameter file's albedo, FROM_VEGHIST the per-step albedo of FORCING2 (io.veghist) (image driver: torchvic/io/options.py, docs/OPTIONS.md)

ALMA_OUTPUT.note: deprecated in VIC 5; the classic driver refuses it

ARNO_PARAMS.note: read as BASEFLOW NIJSSEN2001 (TRUE) or ARNO (FALSE), the replacement VIC's own error text names

ATMOS_STEPS_PER_DAY.note: the classic driver's key; validated as get_global_param.c:811-856 does, no effect on results (it only sets atmos_dt, which is logged)

BASEFLOW.note: ARNO runs as the column (soil.arno_baseflow); NIJSSEN2001 reaches it as ARNO's Ds, Dsmax, Ws, c (soil.nijssen2001_to_arno)

BINARY_OUTPUT.note: deprecated in VIC 5; the classic driver refuses it

BLOWING.note: CalcBlowingSnow.c (torchvic.core.blowing); sigma_slope, lag_one and fetch are read from the classic vegetation file and the image parameter file

BLOWING_CALC_PROB.note: the probability of blowing snow occurring, CalcBlowingSnow.c:582-616; off gives probability 1

BLOWING_FETCH.note: the fetch correction to the saltation transport, CalcBlowingSnow.c:750-752 and :787-789

BLOWING_SPATIAL_WIND.note: the log-normal wind distribution cut into BLOWING_NUMINCS increments, CalcBlowingSnow.c:123-180

BLOWING_VAR_THRESHOLD.note: the variable threshold shear of Li and Pomeroy (1997), CalcBlowingSnow.c:645-650; the constant one is there too

BULK_DENSITY_COMB.note: bulk density is read as the mineral value; the combined-with-organic convention is not honoured

CALENDAR.note: the dates are the forcing file's; a CALENDAR that disagrees with it is refused

CANOPY_LAYERS.note: the canopy is split into Ncanopy layers of equal leaf area for the carbon step, as read_vegparam.c:124-128 splits it, with the absorbed PAR and the nitrogen scaling computed per layer (faparl.c, calc_Nscale_factors.c). Three by default, as VIC has it; basin.simulate takes carbon_options={'ncanopy': n}

CARBON.note: canopy_assimilation and photosynth verified against VIC's own compiled functions to 1e-12 (torchvic.core.carbon), called from the step loop at the point surface_fluxes.c:732 calls them -- after the water and energy are settled, from the canopy resistance the transpiration already computed. With VIC's default RC_MODE of RC_JARVIS the carbon step only reads that resistance, so every water and energy row is bitwise unchanged with CARBON on (tests/test_carbon_run.py). The CATM, PAR and FDIR forcings VIC 5 demands and no sample data has are derived as initialize_atmos.c:1588-1700 derives them (torchvic.forcing.daily, carbon=True). VIC 5's photosynth.c uses a per-kilomole gas constant in nine per-mole formulas, and compute_soil_resp.c divides two of three pool turnover times by hours where dt is seconds; both are reproduced by default and corrected on request (basin.simulate carbon_options). The three soil pools need the surface energy balance for their node temperatures and a soil file with `bubble` for the lumped water table; without either the vegetation fluxes run and the pool rows are absent rather than zero

CLOSE_ENERGY.note: the canopy air temperature is solved and the ground/canopy balances iterate to closure (basin._ce_step)

COMPRESS.note: zlib level of netCDF-4 history files

COMPUTE_TREELINE.note: the classic driver's treeline (compute_treeline.c, put_data.c); VIC's image driver stops on it

CONSTANTS.note: read by GlobalParam.constants(): VEG_LAI_WATER_FACTOR is applied (p['lai_water_factor']); any other constant in the file is refused by name, not ignored

CORRPREC.note: gauge undercatch correction is not applied

DOMAIN.note: the domain file is opened and its mask selects the active cells (vic_image.ImageDomain)

DOMAIN_TYPE.note: every domain variable name is taken from the file, not assumed

ENDDAY.note: the simulation window: torchvic.case.window runs the forcing records from STARTYEAR..STARTSEC to the end of ENDYEAR/ENDMONTH/ENDDAY, or NRECS model steps, and refuses a forcing that does not cover it

ENDMONTH.note: the simulation window: torchvic.case.window runs the forcing records from STARTYEAR..STARTSEC to the end of ENDYEAR/ENDMONTH/ENDDAY, or NRECS model steps, and refuses a forcing that does not cover it

ENDYEAR.note: the simulation window: torchvic.case.window runs the forcing records from STARTYEAR..STARTSEC to the end of ENDYEAR/ENDMONTH/ENDDAY, or NRECS model steps, and refuses a forcing that does not cover it

EQUAL_AREA.note: cell areas come from the domain file (classic driver)

EXP_TRANS.note: the node grid of the finite-difference profile; TRUE with QUICK_FLUX is refused, as VIC refuses it (image driver: torchvic/io/options.py, docs/OPTIONS.md)

FCAN_SRC.note: FROM_DEFAULT, FROM_VEGLIB and FROM_VEGPARAM as VIC (a file without fcanopy refused), FROM_VEGHIST the per-step fcanopy of FORCING2 (io.veghist) (image driver: torchvic/io/options.py, docs/OPTIONS.md)

FORCEYEAR.note: classic forcing start, honoured by vic_classic.ClassicForcing

FORCE_DT.note: forcing step (classic driver); the step comes from the forcing time axis

FORCE_FORMAT.note: ASCII is read by vic_classic.ClassicForcing; BINARY is refused by name

FORCE_STEPS_PER_DAY.note: sets the classic forcing time axis in vic_classic.ClassicForcing

FORCE_TYPE.note: the NetCDF variable holding each forcing is taken from the file

FORCING1.note: the forcing prefix is globbed and every year read (vic_image.ImageForcing)

FORCING2.note: the vegetation history file (io.veghist): LAI, fcanopy and albedo for the *_SRC set to FROM_VEGHIST; VIC reads no other variable from it

FROZEN_SOIL.note: the QUICK_FLUX path: the layer ice the unfrozen-water curve leaves, that ice in the column and in the thermal properties, and the latent heat of fusion in the surface balance; and the full node profile (QUICK_FLUX FALSE, which is what VIC switches to by default under FROZEN_SOIL), solved in torchvic.core.soiltemp

FULL_ENERGY.note: the surface energy balance in torchvic.core.energy: one root find per tile per step, for the configuration with no snow on the surface, no overstory, on the QUICK_FLUX path and on the finite-difference profile; the runner reads the flag from the global file. Snow-coupled and overstory energy terms are not solved yet, and are said so rather than run on the wrong branch

GRID_DECIMAL.note: decimal places in the classic forcing filename (make_in_and_outfiles.c:47-58), honoured by vic_classic

GRND_FLUX_TYPE.note: GF_410 runs as the two-term Liang flux and GF_406 as the surface term alone, on both thermal paths (energy._residual, soiltemp.profile_ground_terms, energy.water_balance_ground_flux)

HISTFREQ.note: history file splitting, VIC's write alarm

IMPLICIT.note: the solver of the finite-difference profile; TRUE with QUICK_FLUX is refused, as VIC refuses it (image driver: torchvic/io/options.py, docs/OPTIONS.md)

INIT_STATE.note: no state is restored; every run starts from torchvic.model.basin.initial_states

JULY_TAVG_SUPPLIED.note: read with COMPUTE_TREELINE, which is the only reader of July_Tavg (image driver: torchvic/io/options.py, docs/OPTIONS.md)

LAI_SRC.note: FROM_VEGLIB and FROM_VEGPARAM read the parameter file's LAI, FROM_VEGHIST the per-step LAI of FORCING2 (io.veghist) (image driver: torchvic/io/options.py, docs/OPTIONS.md)

LAKES.note: all of lakes.eb.c, ice_melt.c, water_energy_balance.c, water_under_ice.c and IceEnergyBalance.c is implemented and verified against VIC's own compiled functions (torchvic.core.lake): the thermal profile and its convective mixing, the open water and under-ice energy balances, the ice and its snowpack, the basin geometry, the water balance and the area the lake trades with the wetland. torchvic.core.lake.lake_step runs one lake tile a step, and a 720-step run tracks VIC to 4e-07 on the lake volume. What is NOT here is the coupling into basin.simulate, which carries one soil column per grid cell rather than the lake-plus-wetland pair this option splits a cell into, so a global file cannot yet reach it

LAKE_NODES.note: the node grid is implemented (MAX_LAKE_NODES = 20, compute_derived_lake_dimensions); the option is unreachable only because LAKES is

LAKE_PROFILE.note: read_lakeparam and compute_lake_params are implemented for both the given and the generated depth-area curve and are exact against VIC (torchvic.core.lake.read_lakeparam); the option is unreachable only because LAKES is

LOG_DIR.note: logging goes to the caller's log function

MAX_SNOW_ALBEDO.note: per-cell maximum snow albedo from the parameter file; TorchVIC uses a single new_snow_albedo run parameter

MAX_SNOW_TEMP.note: the rain/snow partition uses the t_max_snow run parameter, not this key (classic driver)

MIN_RAIN_TEMP.note: the rain/snow partition uses the t_min_rain run parameter, not this key (classic driver)

MODEL_STEPS_PER_DAY.note: the model step: the forcing's own, or 1 (the day's records averaged, vic_force.c:404-412); other steps are refused (image driver: torchvic/io/options.py, docs/OPTIONS.md)

MOISTFRACT.note: deprecated in VIC 5; replaced by the OUT_SOIL_*_FRAC output variables

NIJSSEN2001_BASEFLOW.note: read as BASEFLOW NIJSSEN2001 (TRUE) or ARNO (FALSE), the replacement VIC's own error text names

NLAYER.note: the layer count comes from the parameter file's nlayer dimension, not from the global file

NODES.note: the thermal node count off the QUICK_FLUX path; with QUICK_FLUX VIC resets it to 3

NOFLUX.note: the bottom boundary of the finite-difference profile; not read on the QUICK_FLUX path (image driver: torchvic/io/options.py, docs/OPTIONS.md)

NO_FLUX.note: alias of NOFLUX (image driver: torchvic/io/options.py, docs/OPTIONS.md)

NRECS.note: the simulation window: torchvic.case.window runs the forcing records from STARTYEAR..STARTSEC to the end of ENDYEAR/ENDMONTH/ENDDAY, or NRECS model steps, and refuses a forcing that does not cover it

ORGANIC_FRACT.note: organic soil fractions are not read from the parameter file

OUTFILE.note: one history stream per OUTFILE (torchvic.io.history.parse_streams), written by torchvic run / Case.write_history

OUTPUT_FORCE.note: VIC 4.2.d writes its forcing files (write_forcing_file.c); so does TorchVIC, in the same files

OUTVAR.note: the stream's variables, their AGG_TYPE (5th token; VIC's per-variable default otherwise) and OUT_TYPE; a variable TorchVIC does not compute is named and left out

OUT_DT.note: deprecated in VIC 5; replaced by AGGFREQ

OUT_FORMAT.note: netCDF format of history files (NETCDF4_CLASSIC, the default, is written as netCDF-3 classic, as VIC's get_nc_mode does)

OUT_TIME_UNITS.note: the time units of the history files torchvic.io.history writes (default DAYS, since 0001-01-01 as VIC)

PARAMETERS.note: soil, vegetation and band fields are read from it (vic_image.ImageParams)

PRT_HEADER.note: deprecated in VIC 5; the classic driver refuses it

PRT_SNOW_BAND.note: deprecated in VIC 5; the classic driver refuses it

QUICK_FLUX.note: TRUE is the two-node flux; FALSE solves the finite-difference profile at every trial surface temperature (image driver: torchvic/io/options.py, docs/OPTIONS.md)

QUICK_SOLVE.note: bracketing on the reduced column off the QUICK_FLUX path; with QUICK_FLUX it finds the same root (image driver: torchvic/io/options.py, docs/OPTIONS.md)

RC_MODE.note: RC_JARVIS (default) and RC_PHOTO, the canopy resistance from photosynthetic demand (canopy_evap.c:296-307, penman.c calc_rc_ps); RC_PHOTO needs CARBON, as VIC resets it without. Verified against VIC on Walnut Gulch (verification/matrix.py section 14)

RESOLUTION.note: grid resolution comes from the domain file (classic driver)

RESULT_DIR.note: where torchvic.io.history writes the OUTFILE streams (torchvic run; --result-dir overrides)

ROOT_ZONES.note: root zone count for the classic vegetation file, honoured by vic_classic

ROUT_PARAM.note: routing is a unit hydrograph over one outlet (torchvic.model.routing), not RVIC's parameter file

RUNOFF_STEPS_PER_DAY.note: passed to column.SoilParams and sub-steps the runoff solution

SHARE_LAYER_MOIST.note: both cases of canopy_evap.c:287-362 -- CASE 1, where a layer above its critical moisture makes up the shortfall of a rooted layer below it, and CASE 2, where each layer transpires on its own resistance. vic_classic.py reads the flag and basin.simulate(share_layer_moist=...) selects the case, with VIC's default of TRUE when the key is absent

SKIPYEAR.note: deprecated in the classic driver; the CESM driver parses and drops it

SNOW_BAND.note: TRUE runs only where every cell has one band with area; more bands are refused (one column per cell) (image driver: torchvic/io/options.py, docs/OPTIONS.md)

SNOW_DENSITY.note: only VIC's default DENS_BRAS is implemented (snow.snow_density_bras); a file asking for DENS_SNTHRM would get DENS_BRAS

SNOW_STEPS_PER_DAY.note: must be the forcing's step; a daily model step whose forcing can snow is refused, since VIC sub-steps the snow at this rate and TorchVIC does not (image driver: torchvic/io/options.py, docs/OPTIONS.md)

SOIL.note: the classic ASCII soil file, read by vic_classic.ClassicDomain with the column order generated from read_soilparam.c

SPATIAL_FROST.note: sub-grid frost distribution is not modelled; ice is identically zero

SPATIAL_SNOW.note: calc_snow_coverage.c is implemented and runs from the classic soil file; the image driver refuses TRUE, not verified against VIC (image driver: torchvic/io/options.py, docs/OPTIONS.md)

STARTDAY.note: the simulation window: torchvic.case.window runs the forcing records from STARTYEAR..STARTSEC to the end of ENDYEAR/ENDMONTH/ENDDAY, or NRECS model steps, and refuses a forcing that does not cover it

STARTMONTH.note: the simulation window: torchvic.case.window runs the forcing records from STARTYEAR..STARTSEC to the end of ENDYEAR/ENDMONTH/ENDDAY, or NRECS model steps, and refuses a forcing that does not cover it

STARTSEC.note: the simulation window: torchvic.case.window runs the forcing records from STARTYEAR..STARTSEC to the end of ENDYEAR/ENDMONTH/ENDDAY, or NRECS model steps, and refuses a forcing that does not cover it

STARTYEAR.note: the simulation window: torchvic.case.window runs the forcing records from STARTYEAR..STARTSEC to the end of ENDYEAR/ENDMONTH/ENDDAY, or NRECS model steps, and refuses a forcing that does not cover it

TFALLBACK.note: TRUE (default): a temperature solve with no root keeps the previous temperature and is counted; FALSE stops at the first such solve (surface, snow pack, canopy foliage, canopy air), naming step, cell and solve (core/tfallback.py)

VEGLIB.note: the classic vegetation library, read by vic_classic per read_veglib.c including the bare-soil tile

VEGLIB_FCAN.note: fcanopy column in the classic library, read by vic_classic

VEGLIB_PHOTO.note: the seven photosynthesis columns read_veglib.c:162-192 adds -- Ctype, MaxCarboxRate, MaxETransport, CO2Specificity, NscaleFlag, Wnpp_inhib, NPPfactor_sat -- are read by both the classic library reader and the image parameter reader, and are what CARBON runs on

VEGPARAM.note: the classic per-cell vegetation file, read by vic_classic per read_vegparam.c

VEGPARAM_ALB.note: albedo lines in the classic vegetation file, read by vic_classic

VEGPARAM_FCAN.note: fcanopy lines in the classic vegetation file, read by vic_classic

VEGPARAM_LAI.note: LAI lines in the classic vegetation file, read by vic_classic

WIND_H.note: the wind measurement height, resolved by torchvic.case.resolve_wind_h
